metrics.description: Output must validate against the strategy-to-system JSON schema.
All required planning sections must be present and non-empty.
Required strategic concepts must appear in the output.
Optional judge score for whether the plan is actionable.

allowed_claims: The strategy task family measures structured compilation quality for a synthetic strategy memo.
limitations: The eval card does not prove business strategy correctness.
Judge-only actionability cannot override deterministic schema failures.
